caption:
Hahn is the new Official Beer of the Australian Open.

Lion's flagship beer signs a multi-year deal covering the AO and the Australian Summer of Tennis, with a two-storey Hahn House on Grand Slam Oval. Stone & Wood and Four Pillars come along for the ride. No fee or length disclosed.

Also today: FAGE x WTA Finals, Isuzu x Rugby World Cup 2027, Airwallex x McLaren, Academy Sports + Outdoors x HYROX North America, Introl x Racing Bulls.
